name: Urgency & Countdown Widgets for WooCommerce
author: astertheme

sections.description:
Key Features

🔥 Urgency Widgets (Product Page Display)
* Live Visitor Count
* Cart Activity Count
* Purchase Notification Count
* Low Stock Alert
* Choose between manual values or WooCommerce data
* Display urgency widgets on selected products
* Enable/disable widgets using the Global Toggle Switch

⏰ Countdown Timer (Time-Limited Offers)
* Set start and end date/time for each product countdown
* Add a custom promotional message like “Limited Time Offer” or “30% OFF”
* Assign timers to one or multiple products

🎨 Customization Options
* Adjust font colors, background colors, and font family for urgency widgets
* Modify countdown timer styles and animations for better visibility and engagement

How It Works

  1. Create Urgency Widgets:

    • Add a widget title
    • Choose products
    • Set stock, visitor, cart, and purchase values (real or manual)

  2. Enable Countdown Timers:

    • Define start & end date/time
    • Add a message
    • Assign to products

  3. Customize Appearance:

    • Match widgets to your brand style
    • Choose animations for timers

Why Use This Plugin?

🎯 Create real-time urgency on product pages
📈 Increase conversions with FOMO-driven tactics
🌟 Highlight trending products and low stock
✅ Fully compatible with WooCommerce

Use Cases

⚡ Promote flash sales with a ticking timer
📦 Show “Only 3 left in stock!” urgency alerts
🎭 Simulate store activity for new or low-traffic products
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
What versions of WooCommerce does this plugin support?

✅ The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce 5.0 and above.

Does it work with all themes?

✅ Yes, the plugin is designed to work with all major WordPress themes.

Is the plugin optimized for performance?

✅ Yes, the plugin is lightweight and optimized for speed.
